summary.reading: Each owner's indirect jr / jalr compile to dispatchGuestBranch with the computed target, which looks it up in the function table. An owner 'ran' when any of its indirect sites appears in the trace (which sees every indirect dispatch from generated code with PS2X_FAST_DISPATCH=0); its 'missing' is 0 when every target it reached was registered. Owners not reached did not run an indirect dispatch on this route. No missing-target or unlisted-resume report in a log means the entry list held every branch target and resume point of that run.
